cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
마라우돈 흑석반지 떴다!
냥꾼이랑 나만 굴리면 되네~
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon cut on pure #FFFFFF background, slight low-angle three-quarter shot. Troll Shaman on the left and Dwarf Hunter on the right (both with weapons cleanly stowed on their backs) gaze excitedly with sparkling eyes at a dark stone ring hovering over a cute 2.5-head chibi SD dungeon treasure chest on a minimal purple crystal floor patch. A cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub beside Dwarf Hunter cheers with raised paws.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
잠깐, 천 딜러인 흑마님이
물리 반지를 왜 먹어요?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon cut on pure #FFFFFF background, diagonal over-the-shoulder shot. Dwarf Hunter on the left (gun slung on her back, hands thrown up in shock) stares wide-eyed with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub mimicking her stunned face. Human Warlock on the right (tome stowed) casually holds a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube die with round dot pips only (no digits) in one hand and the dark stone ring in the other, while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD floating purple Voidwalker blinks innocently beside her.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
어라? 술사님, 반지 한 칸은
왜 몰래 빼두셨어요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon cut on pure #FFFFFF background, side-profile peeking medium shot. Dwarf Hunter leans in sharply from the left with a suspicious squinting stare (weapon stowed, cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub peeking beside her), pointing toward Troll Shaman on the right. Troll Shaman freezes mid-step on a minimal stone ground patch, awkwardly hiding one ring behind her back while her other visible hand shows a conspicuously bare ring finger.

Cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon cut on pure #FFFFFF background, huge silent bust-up close-up filling 80% of the frame height. Troll Shaman on the left is frozen stiff with exaggerated sweat drops, hastily cramming her removed spare ring back onto her finger. Human Warlock on the right stares rigidly straight ahead with blank deadpan eyes and cold sweat, while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD purple Voidwalker beside her also sweats nervously.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
어, 잠깐 뺐다 낀 거야!
우린 길드만 같지 남이라고~
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon cut on pure #FFFFFF background, three-quarter medium shot on minimal dungeon ground. Troll Shaman on the left (weapons stowed) waves both empty-looking hands defensively with a strained, sweaty grin. Human Warlock on the right looks sharply away whistling awkwardly while clutching the looted dark stone ring behind her back, her cute 2.5-head chibi SD purple Voidwalker peeking out behind her shoulder.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
대리 입찰에 발뺌까지…
어이없어서 파탈도 까먹었네!
cuts.visual_prompt: Cute 2.5-head chibi SD webtoon cut on pure #FFFFFF background, comedic high-angle shot. Dwarf Hunter sits slumped in the center-left on a minimal cave floor patch clutching her forehead in sheer disbelief (gun slung on her back), with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub sitting beside her drooping its ears. In the far right background, tiny distant silhouettes of a rushing shaman and warlock scurry deeper into the cave.
